nodes.summary: There are a vertex set $V$, a set $E$ of finite subsets of $V$ and a natural number $k$ such that every edge in $E$ has at most $k$ elements, but the hypergraph with edge set $E$ has no strongly maximal matching.
nodes.title: Bounded edge size does not guarantee a strongly maximal matching

nodes.summary: The statement that for every vertex set $V$ and every set $E$ of finite subsets of $V$ such that some natural number $k$ bounds the number of elements of every edge in $E$, the hypergraph with edge set $E$ has a strongly maximal matching.
nodes.title: Strongly maximal matchings in hypergraphs with bounded edges

nodes.summary: There are a type $V$, a set $E$ of finite subsets of $V$ (the edges of a hypergraph) and a natural number $k$ such that every edge in $E$ is nonempty and has at most $k$ elements, but no strongly minimal cover of $E$ exists. Here a cover of $E$ is a set $X \subseteq V$ that meets every edge in $E$, and a cover $X$ is strongly minimal if $|X \setminus X'| \le |X' \setminus X|$, as cardinals, for every cover $X'$ of…
nodes.title: Aharoni's strongly minimal cover conjecture is false

nodes.summary: The statement that for every type $V$, every set $E$ of finite subsets of $V$ (the edges of a hypergraph, possibly infinitely many) and every natural number $k$ such that each edge in $E$ is nonempty and has at most $k$ elements, the hypergraph with edge set $E$ has a strongly minimal cover.
nodes.title: Aharoni's strongly minimal cover conjecture

nodes.summary: For a hypergraph on a vertex set $V$ whose edges form a set $E$ of finite subsets of $V$, a set $M$ is a matching when $M \subseteq E$ and any two distinct members of $M$ are disjoint.
nodes.title: Matching in a hypergraph

nodes.summary: For a hypergraph with edge set $E$, a set $M$ is a strongly maximal matching (Aharoni) when $M$ is a matching of $E$ and every matching $M'$ of $E$ satisfies $|M' \setminus M| \le |M \setminus M'|$, comparing the cardinalities as cardinal numbers.
nodes.title: Strongly maximal matching

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a set of finite subsets of a type $V$, the edges of a hypergraph. A set $X \subseteq V$ is a strongly minimal cover of $E$ (Aharoni) if $X$ is a cover of $E$, that is, it meets every edge in $E$, and $|X \setminus X'| \le |X' \setminus X|$, as cardinals, for every cover $X'$ of $E$.
nodes.title: Strongly minimal cover

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a set of finite subsets of a type $V$, the edges of a hypergraph. A set $X \subseteq V$ is a (vertex) cover of $E$ if it meets every edge: every $e \in E$ contains some $v \in X$.
nodes.title: Vertex cover of a hypergraph
